annotations.title: utilpeek: read NVMe SMART wear and data written, not just PASSED

description: utilpeek: Check an SSD's wear from smartctl or nvme smart-log. Returns SSD wear from smartctl or nvme smart-log text/JSON: percentage used (can pass the full rated endurance), host TB written (NVMe data units × 512,000 bytes / 10^12), optional rated-TBW share and gap, spare vs threshold, warnings, errors, shutdowns and hours, with an ok / worn / failing verdict and reasons. Only the pasted report is read; no commands run or network calls. SMART PASSED does not rule out failure; SATA wear is vendor-specific. Invalid reports/ratings: 422, not charged. Shares the utilpeek free pool. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored.

rated_tbw.description: Optional maker's rated endurance in decimal TB written (TBW).
rated_tbw.title: Rated Tbw

report.description: smartctl -a/-j or nvme smart-log text or JSON. No commands run or URLs fetched.
report.title: Report

name: check_ssd_health

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
